name: Plane-based Quadratic 4D Interpolation
definition: A method to interpolate multi-resolution volumetric fields (opacity and radiance) stored in a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) using local plane samples (function value and spatial gradient) to achieve quadratic accuracy in 3D space and linear accuracy in Level-of-Detail (LoD) space.
summary: Plane-based Quadratic 4D Interpolation uses local plane samples to achieve quadratic 3D accuracy, allowing field extrema to be positioned continuously rather than fixed to discrete node centers.
